newsitem.title: LATVIA: MARCH PPI UP 0.5 PCT MO/MO, 5.2 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: MARCH PPI UP 0.5 PCT MO/MO, 5.2 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Latvia's producer price index rose by 0.5 percent in March on a month-on-month basis for a 5.2 percent year-on-year rise, the statistics committee said on Friday.

The committe said in a statement that during the year from March 1996 to March 1997, the quickest rise in prices was in water output, purification and distribution, where the price rise was 18.7 percent.
It said that over the 12 months, rubber and plastics products rose 10.4 percent, and in the radio and TV equipment production by 10.0 percent.
In the timber and wood production sector, excluding furniture production, the price rise was 8.3 percent.
Between March and February, the fastest price rise was in scrap-metal processing at 5.2 percent and non-metal mineral products at 3.2 percent.
